events.description: Company reported receiving a corrected City determination asserting a $3.8 million access line tax deficiency.
Company reported depositing the full disputed amount under protest.
Company reported filing an administrative refund claim for the full deposit.
Company disclosed a separate Superior Court refund complaint.
Company disclosed the City’s answer to its complaint.

limitation: The filings state the company’s position. No judgment or refund ledger has been verified. This deposit is excluded from the $21,340,000 authorized in the different multi-carrier litigation.
